definitions.explanation: The study and description of the natural world — animals, plants, minerals, and their history — especially through observation and classification.

examples.japanese: {自然史|しぜんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I am interested in natural history.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自然史|しぜんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That museum has an extensive natural history exhibit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恐竜|きょうりゅう}→恐竜：10428_kyouryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自然史|しぜんし}⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Dinosaur fossils are one of the popular exhibits at natural history museums.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧ (nature) + ⟦{史|し}→〜史：28471_shi⟧ (history). Covers the descriptive study of the natural world, including animals, plants, rocks, and fossils.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然史|しぜんし}⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧: a natural history museum
- {自然史|しぜんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: natural history research

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {博物学|はくぶつがく}: natural history — a near-synonym, especially for the older field of collecting and classifying specimens
